description: This file is an HTML webpage implementing a database visualizer interface with embedded CSS and JavaScript for dynamic functionality like fetching databases, tables, and table data, and rendering it interactively.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets selection, and triggers reload.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables belonging to a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML table from data array.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates individual cell HTML, handles complex objects and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content on click for long or object data.
